findings: Independent audit corrections (2026-11-10, reports/conductor-parity-audit.html): five rows are capped at partial because they passed on a weaker bar than the Conductor column: real-model agent run, subscription sign-in, default machine size, and the download and remote-desktop UIs. Four rows Conductor has that our bar left out are added as not landed: local core workflow, Run actions with per-workspace ports, read-while-asleep from any device, and per-turn code checkpoints. Our 'pass' counts measure the team's own bar. Every cloud result is on dev Workers, Stripe TEST mode and dev/staging tokens; nothing is shipped (mvp-tracker §5 launch items are all open).

Wake delivery (target p95 < 6 s): latest is golden snap_6kSW (543cff4: #173 V8 code cache, #175 sealed offer + 10 ms ready poll), n=22, persistent connection. Total p50 4.78 s, p95 6.31 s, p99 7.87 s. Phases p50 / p95 / p99: Vercel resume to orcad spawn 2.99 / 4.29 / 5.46 s; orcad ready 1.04 / 1.53 / 1.70 s; first list 0.44 / 0.48 / 0.56 s; terminal create 0.15 / 0.23 / 0.25 s; echo 0.15 / 0.16 / 0.16 s. History (p50 / p95): pre-#141 7.7 / 9.5 s; #141 6.8 / 11.0 s; #151/#162 5.13 / 6.49 s; #173/#175 4.78 / 6.31 s. The p95 gap is now almost all Vercel resume.

Rows closed 2026-11-10: real 15-min idle sleep: an idle VM with no client stopped by itself after 19.2 min. Agent sign-in persistence: Claude answers, onboarding is pre-seeded, and the auth homes are kept fresh, after a wake and after a rollover. Auto-resume after Restart on m4air: one continue 29.4 s after the click, turn finished, no double continue. Wake on message: a message to a sleeping workspace was delivered in 6.1 s. Scheduled routine: fired by itself and succeeded on a fresh VM, which was then destroyed. File search: ripgrep over the pairing found both needles in 5,002 files, p50 88 ms. Usage metering: control-plane outbox, then billing hours, then the Stripe meter. Overage cap blocks new starts at $5. Dunning end to end: grace expiry (past_due_since backdated 97 h) leads the control-plane cron to suspend the running VM in 123 s; paying lets the account start again and the VM resumes. Desktop keystroke n=50: p50/p95/p99 84/94/144 ms; the 407 ms outlier did not recur. Web client is post-MVP.

Control-plane billing gate (closed via core #166): a dev:billing-test-* account goes through the real billing Worker. No plan → 403 no_subscription; active plan → 200; 4th concurrent VM on 1 seat → 403; included hours used up → 403; failed renewal → 403 payment_past_due; grace expired → the running VM was suspended by the cron in 71 s and resume → 403; paid → resume 200. Staging team checks pass again (teams are deleted by the shared cleanup script).

CLI create (closed via W5 #167): orca worktree create --on cloud --repo … with an API key, headless: running in 3.7 s; orca cloud workspace destroy works; signed out gives cloud_not_signed_in. Move, Sleep, then Delete: no wake, destroyed, Vercel 404, no misleading toasts. Row removal went from 31 s to 1.5 s / 1.7 s after core #171, which skips the hooks check for asleep sandboxes.

orca.yaml setup in the VM (closed via core #168): an API-created workspace on test-repo branch w9-setup-script ran scripts.setup inside the VM exactly once, including after sleep/wake. The environment-build skip path is unit-tested by core; the desktop path runs after the trust prompt.

W1-1 (fixed, #118/#123): builds used to advance only while a client streamed /events; GET polling sat in running for 25 min. With the Durable Object runner deployed, builds finish when the client only polls GET: build 1 of a fresh environment in 17 s, build 2 in 18 s. An earlier 250 s first build had started before #123 went live. The harness now polls by default; ORCA_ACCEPTANCE_BUILD_EVENTS=1 follows the events stream.

D-1 (bug, core desktop, high): — fixed in #127 (bab8369a229); main-process paths verified headlessly by core against the dev control plane; desktop UI re-run pending (no-windows rule): starting an Orca Cloud create before signing in, then signing in from the card, created a sandbox owned by the fallback dev user (desktop-dogfood), not the signed-in user. Keep-alive, Copy SSH Command and Delete then got not_found. Likely cause: getHostedSandboxConfig() caches the token for the app process and does not reset it on sign-in (src/main/hosted-sandbox/hosted-sandbox-config.ts).

D-2 (bug, core desktop, high): — fixed in #127 (bab8369a229); main-process paths verified headlessly by core against the dev control plane; desktop UI re-run pending (no-windows rule): Delete Workspace hides the row and reports success when the control plane answers not_found, while the VM keeps running (a billing leak).

D-3 (bug, core desktop): — fixed in #127 (bab8369a229); main-process paths verified headlessly by core against the dev control plane; desktop UI re-run pending (no-windows rule): after a cloud create, the checkout at /vercel/sandbox/project is added as a new project named "project" instead of being grouped under orca-sandbox-push-test.

W3-dl (pass): download over ONE persistent paired connection (the desktop lane): 50 MiB in 3.5 s (14.2 MiB/s from iad1 to this Mac, sha256 matches), 50 MiB folder zip in 5.4 s and complete. That matches W3's desktop numbers (50 MiB p50 15.3 MB/s; 200 MiB about 19 MiB/s; 2,000-file zip 1.8 s). The earlier 1.5 MiB/s came from the harness opening a new connection per RPC (corrected).

Remote desktop (pass): the harness verifies the route and the ticket gate (101 with a ticket, 403 with a bogus one). W3 re-verified end to end with no manual steps: ticket mint p50 282 ms, connected in 130 ms, ticket reuse and a wrong Origin both 403. #138 (polish) and #146 (0-RTT forward open, p50 127 to 64 ms) ship with the next golden.

D-4 (minor, desktop): — fixed in #127 (bab8369a229); main-process paths verified headlessly by core against the dev control plane; desktop UI re-run pending (no-windows rule): the "Sign in to use Orca Cloud" card stays after sign-in; the Ports panel says "Port scan unavailable on unknown" while waking; "Move to this computer" has no confirmation and copies rather than moves (the VM keeps running); the agent picker is disabled for Orca Cloud.

W6-1 (resolved): provider keys are now egress placeholders in orcad's env (swap on by default on dev), so sec.precedence reads AWS_REGION. W6 confirmed the swap resolves keys with the same precedence as injection (team > repo > personal for agent keys) and added a test at the egress proxy (cloud/w6-precedence-test). Real Claude Code and Codex PRs: nwparker/orca-sandbox-push-test#5, #6.

Fixed since the last report: F1 resume on a running sandbox now returns in 0.5 s (was a 60 s 502); F3 ai-gateway.vercel.sh is allowlisted (real Claude Code task passes); F4 the image now has orca, rg, tmux, vim, git-lfs and Chrome; F5 disk is 64 GB.
Note: kill-switch drain mode is not exercised on the shared dev Worker (it would suspend other workstreams' sandboxes); refusal of creates and wakes is verified.
Stray sandbox resolved: desktop-dogfood's sbx_36ffc95c… was W2's w2predict sandbox, created by ~/w2-close/launch.sh with ORCA_CLOUD_DEV_USER_ID=desktop-dogfood, and has been deleted.
